text_en: At that time Herod the ruler heard reports about Jesus;
text_cn: 那时，分封侯黑落德听到耶稣的名声，

text_en: and he said to his servants, “This is John the Baptist; he has been raised from the dead, and for this reason these powers are at work in him. ”
text_cn: 就对他的臣仆说：“这是洗者若翰，他由死者中复活了；为此，这些奇能才在他身上运行。”

text_en: For Herod had arrested John, bound him, and put him in prison on account of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife,
text_cn: 原来，黑落德为了他兄弟斐理伯的妻子黑落狄雅的原故，逮捕了若翰，把他囚在监里，

text_en: because John had been telling him, “It is not lawful for you to have her. ”
text_cn: 因为若翰曾给他说：“你不可占有这个女人！”

text_en: Though Herod wanted to put him to death, he feared the crowd, because they regarded him as a prophet.
text_cn: 黑落德本有意杀他，但害怕群众，因为他们都以若翰为先知。

text_en: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced before the company, and she pleased Herod
text_cn: 到了黑落德的生日，黑落狄雅的女儿，在席间跳舞，中悦了黑落德；

text_en: so much that he promised on oath to grant her whatever she might ask.
text_cn: 为此，黑落德发誓许下，她无论求什么，都要给她。

text_en: Prompted by her mother, she said, “Give me the head of John the Baptist here on a platter. ”
text_cn: 她受了她母亲的唆使后，就说：“请就地把若翰的头放在盘子里给我！”

text_en: The king was grieved, yet out of regard for his oaths and for the guests, he commanded it to be given;
text_cn: 王十分忧郁，但为了誓言和同席的人，就下令给她。

text_en: he sent and had John beheaded in the prison.
text_cn: 遂差人在监里斩了若翰的头，

text_en: The head was brought on a platter and given to the girl, who brought it to her mother.
text_cn: 把头放在盘子里拿来，给了女孩；女孩便拿去给了她母亲。

text_en: His disciples came and took the body and buried it; then they went and told Jesus.
text_cn: 若翰的门徒前来，领了尸身，埋葬了，然后去报告给耶稣。

text_en: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place by himself. But when the crowds heard it, they followed him on foot from the towns.
text_cn: 耶稣一听说这消息，就从那里上船，私下退到荒野地方；群众听说了，就从各城里步行跟了他去。

text_en: When he went ashore, he saw a great crowd; and he had compassion for them and cured their sick.
text_cn: 他一下船，看见一大伙群众，便对他们动了怜悯的心，治好了他们的病人。

text_en: When it was evening, the disciples came to him and said, “This is a deserted place, and the hour is now late; send the crowds away so that they may go into the villages and buy food for themselves. ”
text_cn: 到了傍晚，门徒到他跟前说：“这地方是荒野，时候已不早了，请你遣散群众吧！叫他们各自到村庄去买食物。”

text_en: Jesus said to them, “They need not go away; you give them something to eat. ”
text_cn: 耶稣却对他们说：“他们不必去，你们给他们吃的吧！”

text_en: They replied, “We have nothing here but five loaves and two fish. ”
text_cn: 门徒对他说：“我们这里什么也没有，只有五个饼和两条鱼。”

text_en: And he said, “Bring them here to me. ”
text_cn: 耶稣说：“你们给我拿到这里来！”

text_en: Then he ordered the crowds to sit down on the grass. Taking the five loaves and the two fish, he looked up to heaven, and blessed and broke the loaves, and gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the crowds.
text_cn: 遂又吩咐群众坐在草地上，然后拿起那五个饼和两条鱼，望天祝福了；把饼擘开，递给门徒，门徒再分给群众。

text_en: And all ate and were filled; and they took up what was left over of the broken pieces, twelve baskets full.
text_cn: 众人吃了，也都饱了；然后他们把剩余的碎块收了满满十二筐。

text_en: And those who ate were about five thousand men, besides women and children.
text_cn: 吃的人数，除了妇女和小孩外，约有五千。

text_en: Immediately he made the disciples get into the boat and go on ahead to the other side, while he dismissed the crowds.
text_cn: 耶稣即刻催迫门徒上船，在他以先到对岸去；这其间，他遣散了群众。

text_en: And after he had dismissed the crowds, he went up the mountain by himself to pray. When evening came, he was there alone,
text_cn: 耶稣遣散了群众以后，便私自上山祈祷去了。到了夜晚，他独自一人在那里。

text_en: but by this time the boat, battered by the waves, was far from the land, for the wind was against them.
text_cn: 船已离岸几里了，受着波浪的颠簸，因为吹的是逆风。

text_en: And early in the morning he came walking toward them on the sea.
text_cn: 夜间四更时分，耶稣步行海上，朝着他们走来。

text_en: But when the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were terrified, saying, “It is a ghost! ” And they cried out in fear.
text_cn: 门徒看见他在海上行走，就惊骇说：“是个妖怪。”并且吓得大叫起来。

text_en: But immediately Jesus spoke to them and said, “Take heart, it is I; do not be afraid. ”
text_cn: 耶稣立即向他们说道：“放心！是我。不必害怕！”

text_en: Peter answered him, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the water. ”
text_cn: 伯多禄回答说：“主，如果是你，就叫我在水面上步行到你那里吧！”

text_en: He said, “Come. ” So Peter got out of the boat, started walking on the water, and came toward Jesus.
text_cn: 耶稣说：“来吧！”伯多禄遂从船上下来，走在水面上，往耶稣那里去。

text_en: But when he noticed the strong wind, he became frightened, and beginning to sink, he cried out, “Lord, save me! ”
text_cn: 但他一见风势很强，就害怕起来，并开始下沉，遂大叫说：“主，救我吧！”

text_en: Jesus immediately reached out his hand and caught him, saying to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt? ”
text_cn: 耶稣立刻伸手拉住他，对他说：“小信德的人哪！你为什么怀疑？”

text_en: When they got into the boat, the wind ceased.
text_cn: 他们一上了船，风就停了。

text_en: And those in the boat worshiped him, saying, “Truly you are the Son of God. ”
text_cn: 船上的人便朝拜他说：“你真是天主子。”

text_en: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret.
text_cn: 他们渡到对岸，来到革乃撒勒地方。

text_en: After the people of that place recognized him, they sent word throughout the region and brought all who were sick to him,
text_cn: 那地方的人一认出是耶稣，就打发人到周围整个地方，把一切患病的人，都带到耶稣跟前，

text_en: and begged him that they might touch even the fringe of his cloak; and all who touched it were healed.
text_cn: 求耶稣让他们只摸摸他的衣边；凡摸着的，就痊愈了。
